entries.observed_features: Non-person architectural scene: an empty legislative chamber with no visible people and therefore no source headgear, hair, brows, facial hair, glasses, clothing or neckline to transfer. Preserve the symmetrical dark wood-paneled chamber, central elevated dark green chair/rostrum, central table with papers/books and small desktop objects, rows of green upholstered benches and dark wood rails/desks on both sides, and the central grey aisle bordered by paired red lines. Do not invent a person, mascot head or portrait bust.

A three-person indoor map-room scene, not a single portrait. Preserve three separate unheadgeared men in dark military uniforms: the left light-grey/white-haired man leans over the table in profile/three-quarter view and extends one hand toward a map; the center short grey-brown-haired man stands upright behind the table with red/gold collar and shoulder details and a pale neck order; the right white-haired man stands near-frontal in a similar dark uniform with red/gold accents. The left uniform also has conspicuous gold cuff bands. Tiny brows, eyewear and facial hair cannot be resolved and must not be invented. Preserve the large red/pale/dark flag with a dark cross, circular wall relief, framed wall items and right-hand wall map, plus the red-brown table covered with cream maps, papers and open books.

No person, headgear-as-clothing, hair, facial hair or glasses is present; preserve an object-only scene. One tall ornate gilded throne with deep red upholstered back and seat, carved gold frame, curved open arms and decorative legs. One jeweled gold-and-red crown rests on the seat, with one small round gold orb-like regalia object beside it. Burgundy walls carry repeated white eagle motifs and gold architectural molding above a red floor.

No person, hair, facial hair, headgear-as-clothing or glasses is present; preserve an architecture-only scene. A monumental light beige stone building with a tall columned portico, carved cornices, rows of dark windows, rooftop statuary and one large ribbed verdigris-green dome at upper right. One red hanging flag with a bold white cross is visible on the lower-left facade.

No person, hair, facial hair, wearable headgear or glasses is present; preserve the emblem-only subject. A cream/gold neoclassical building emblem with a central triangular pediment, columned facade, dark windows and two flanking wings. In front is one red heraldic shield with one large white cross and dark outline, flanked by two curved metallic silver-and-gold laurel sprays.
